page.layout: One scan showing the front board of a bound book: blind-tooled leather cover with a decorative frame, a dark ink stamp or device at the centre, and two metal clasps on the right edge. No printed text block on this scan.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of a binding, not a printed page. The only mark is a dark ink device or stamp at the centre of the cover, which is not printed text and is not transcribed. Blind-tooled ornaments, cover stains and the metal clasps are likewise not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
